content.name: EOC - Executive Operations Center
content.description:
# EOC - Executive Operations Center
Transform your X4 empire from reactive management into intelligent operations.
EOC continuously observes your empire, understands what each station is trying to accomplish, identifies recurring operational problems, and provides evidence-based recommendations while keeping every important decision under your control.
---
## Important Startup Timing
After loading a game, wait approximately **10 seconds** for EOC to complete its initial station scan before opening the Executive Operations Center. The readiness summary confirms that current operational intelligence is available.
---
# What EOC Does
### Understands Your Empire EOC learns what your stations are designed to do, understands their operational role, recognizes temporary mission-driven activity, and helps you focus on problems that matter.
### Executive Intelligence Monitor empire health, operational KPIs, trends, ranked priorities, native graphs, and executive summaries.
### Intelligent Station Management Assign persistent station roles and receive recommendations tailored to each station's purpose.
### Guided Recovery EOC explains the primary blocker, presents supporting evidence, recommends the next player action, and verifies whether conditions improve.
### Mission-Aware Analysis EOC recognizes major mission activity such as Terraforming instead of treating intentional demand as an ordinary failure.
### Smart Trade, Shipping, and Logistics Register eligible ships, identify supply shortages, review available capacity, and assign logistics only within player-approved authority.
### Fleet Build Manager Create reusable fleet templates, search owned blueprints, preview construction, and confirm builds only after deliberate player approval.
### Cases and Operational Verification Track critical, warning, monitored, and player-requested cases with visible supporting evidence and verification.
### Executive Reports Generate immediate operational reports with permanent copies in the Logbook Tips system.
### Always Player Controlled EOC advises first and acts only within authority explicitly granted by the player. No free ships, hidden automation, resource bypasses, or unauthorized credit movement.
---
# New in EOC 3.2 GA
- Graph-first KPI dashboards for Player Wealth, Case Trends, and Empire Growth with 5, 10, and 30-minute ranges. - Bounded five-row KPI detail pages across cash flow, profit, construction, shortages, attention, trade, logistics, storage, workforce, shipyards, earners, and drains. - Shipyard Activity reports actual ship workload rather than station-module construction. - Background shipyard polling reduced to five minutes; construction and matching checks reduced to two minutes. - Observation-only visibility for compatible available ships that are not yet EOC-registered. - Zero-default global minimum policies for mining, trade, build-storage trade, defence, and escorts. - Two-step Clear All EOC Cases action with immediate MONITORING / STABLE reset and one fresh analysis. - Non-healthy station status now requires a visible supporting case or retained evidence. - Improved player-case evidence handoff and proven terminal no-match diagnostics.
Compatible with X4 8.x and 9.x.
